description: This file defines the interface for the Rialto control component, including the IControl and IControlFactory classes, which provide APIs for control of IPC and shared memory, as well as factory creation of control instances.

classes.name: IControlFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IControl.

classes.name: IControl
classes.description: Interface defining control operations for Rialto, including client registration.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IControlFactory instance.

methods.name: createControl
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IControl instance.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a new IControlClient and provides the current application state.
